import hashlib, json, re
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit

class Links(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
        self.href = None
        self.label = []
        self.links = set()
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag == 'a':
            self.href = dict(attrs).get('href')
            self.label = []
    def handle_data(self, text):
        if self.href:
            self.label.append(text)
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag != 'a' or not self.href:
            return
        url = urljoin('https://docs.lemonsqueezy.com/help', self.href)
        parts = urlsplit(url)
        label = ' '.join(''.join(self.label).split())
        if parts.scheme == 'https' and parts.hostname == 'docs.lemonsqueezy.com' and parts.path.startswith('/help/') and re.search(r'marketplace|activat|payout|verification|prohibited.products', parts.path + ' ' + label, re.I):
            self.links.add(('https://docs.lemonsqueezy.com' + parts.path, label))
        self.href = None

root = Path('products/services/catalogue-qa-digital-checkout')
result = {'scope': 'Navigation links only. Linked rules, approval, and discovery are unverified.', 'sources': []}
for path in sorted((root / 'raw').glob('*.html')):
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    parser = Links()
    parser.feed(raw.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))
    result['sources'].append({'path': str(path), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'links': [{'url': url, 'label': label} for url, label in sorted(parser.links)]})
assert result['sources'], 'No saved official pages were supplied'
output = root / 'official-rule-link-index.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'artifact': str(output), 'distinct_links': sorted({link['url'] for source in result['sources'] for link in source['links']})}))
